failure_reason: One genuine Clearance PLP was found and confirmed for the Home & Kitchen department, but noon.com's own UI only displays a rounded/bucketed count ('3K+'), never an exact number, so qty is recorded as null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag per the qty rule rather than the row being unqualified.
notes:
SCOPE: Home & Kitchen department per task instruction. ACCESS: same as Bestsellers/New Arrivals -- curl_cffi (Chrome TLS impersonation) reached the site reliably (HTTP 200); plain curl/PowerShell/urllib and Playwright's bundled Chromium could not complete the connection to noon.com from this environment. robots.txt explicitly allows ClaudeBot.

DISCOVERY: checked the Home & Kitchen mega-menu and the /home-kitchen/, /home-decor/, /furniture/, /kitchen-dining/, /tools-and-home-improvement-store/, /bath-and-bedding/ landing pages for any Clearance section. Only /home-kitchen/ (the whole-department landing page) carries a dedicated Clearance carousel; none of the 5 sub-department pages (Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen & Dining, Tools, Bath & Bedding) has its own Clearance carousel or tab -- unlike Bestsellers/New Arrivals there is no tabbed per-department Clearance module, confirmed by inspecting the raw widget markup (plain productCarousel, not a tabsModule).

SALE VS. CLEARANCE JUDGMENT: two candidate banners/carousels were found on /home-kitchen/:
1. 'Clearance deals' carousel -> /clearance-home-may-26-ae/ -- INCLUDED. The page's own H2/heading is literally 'Clearance deals' (one of the brief's exact target terms), a genuinely distinct product listing (3K+ results, not the whole department). The '-may-26-' segment in the URL is just noon's routine internal CMS page-code convention (seen on many of their evergreen tag pages, e.g. the bestseller '-AE' suffixes), not a dated/thematic signal in the visible title itself, so it was not treated as evidence of a temporary campaign.
2. 'Back to school home deals' banner -> /hnk-bts-clearance-26-ae/ -- EXCLUDED. Despite the URL slug containing the word 'clearance', the page's own displayed title is 'Back to school home deals' with no clearance/outlet/final-sale wording anywhere in the heading -- this is a themed seasonal/back-to-school promotional campaign, which Sec 3 explicitly excludes ('seasonal promotion pages ... unless the actual page is a genuine PLP that the site's own taxonomy treats as Clearance'). Not flagged ambiguous because the mismatch between URL slug and the site's own displayed taxonomy label is a clear, confident signal, not a close call.

No local-language (Arabic) equivalent search was separately performed beyond the uae-en English locale; the site's default /uae-en/ pages were used throughout.
